axes: Unreal: X forward, Y right, Z up; origin on the ground under the hip sockets; _l = left side (-Y), _r = right side (+Y)
angles: from the neutral standing pose. bend: side-plane rotation (+ raises neck/head/tail, swings hip/shoulder forward, bends knee/elbow/ankle/toes more, opens jaw). side: left/right, or + = away from the body for hip/shoulder. twist: roll around the bone.
use: limits are the most the bones and ligaments allow; keep everyday moves to about two thirds of them

footfall_order: left hind, left front, right hind, right front (quarter-stride apart)
tissue_note: tissue: the flesh around a bone, the body's muscle anchors: stations [t along the bone (0 its joint, 1 the next), centre across (cm, + right), centre up, half-width, half-height], in the bone's frame; the flesh flows from station to station along each chain of bones (body_tools/grow_body.py measures them from the hand-built body and grows bodies from them). Feet, hands, heads and other bone parts keep their own meshes.

leg_check.summary: Legs hold it: the front legs have 3.4 times the muscle their share of the weight needs.

swim_check.summary: Swims: floats 23 degrees nose-down with its back 9 cm out of the water, holds its nostrils 27 cm clear and paddles at about 3.0 m/s (its legs push 266 N against the drag of 0.05 m² of body under water).

climb_check.summary: Climbs slopes up to 45 degrees: steeper than that its clawed toes slip. It keeps full speed all the way up.

gait_check.summary: Gaits from its legs: 0.9 m high against the Pteranodon's 0.9 m, 3.4 times as strong as their load against 8.3: it walks at 0.7 m/s (1.1 m strides) and its fast walk (amble) reaches 2.1 m/s. Its legs are too weak to run (3.4 times their load; that takes 4.0), so its fastest is a fast walk (amble).

flight_rule: flies if weight / wing area <= 245 N/m^2 and flight muscle >= 15% of body weight; passes the first but not the second = glide only

flight_check.summary: Can't fly: wing loading 490 N/m² is 2 times the 245 limit. The body is too heavy for these wings; it would need wings 8 m across.
